note: Read London on week-on-week and year-on-year movement; the weekly targets are shown for reference only. London booked 2,546 GA4 bookings, down 16.2 percent week on week and down 22.1 percent year on year. Two things frame that fall. First, this reporting week opens on the UK late-summer bank holiday (Mon 31 Aug), while the 364-day comparison week (1–7 Sep 2025) is a clean back-to-work week — the 2025 holiday sat in the previous comparison week, so the year-on-year gap is overstated. Second, website users fell at five of six venues, so this is a traffic step-down rather than a conversion failure: portfolio conversion held at 5.8 percent. Aqua Shard remains the structural issue at −49.7 percent year on year on users −27.2 percent, the continuation of the deliberate the-shard.com free-to-paid referral shift plus an organic visibility problem. Azzurra was the only venue up week on week (+3.7 percent). DSL is measured against a pre-rebrand target and is not comparable; its +187 percent year on year reflects a low 2025 base, not a like-for-like gain. Covers, reported separately, are up 24.4 percent year on year on the same week — GA4 cannot see OpenTable or most of Google Reserve, so read the two together.
